name: substrait
description: Build and deploy apps on the Substrait platform from Claude Code. Bundles the substrait-app skill (scaffold apps to the upload/deploy contract) plus /substrait:init to initialize a folder as a Substrait project (scaffold from empty, or convert an existing codebase), /substrait:login to authenticate your Substrait account and /substrait:logout to sign the machine out again, /substrait:link and /substrait:deploy to connect a local project to a Substrait app and ship it without leaving the terminal, /substrait:env to manage the app's environment variables and secrets, and /substrait:library to browse the platform's API Library and design apps against existing APIs.

portal_url.title: Substrait portal URL
portal_url.description: Base URL of your Substrait installation, e.g. https://app.substrait.build. Optional: you can also pass --portal-url to /substrait:login. There is no default — Substrait is multi-tenant, so a wrong default would silently target the wrong installation.
